newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish zloty tumbles vs basket as dollar soars.
newsitem.headline: Polish zloty tumbles vs basket as dollar soars.

text.p: The Polish zloty sank against the basket of currencies, especially to the dollar, under weight of the robust gains by the U.S. currency, client orders and speculative purchases, dealers said.

The zloty tumbled to a low of 2.7770/85 to the dollar on Tuesday after Monday's close at 2.7610/20, it gained only slightly against the mark, which lost to half a pfenig to the dollar on world markets.
"Trade was very hectic today and turnover was heavy with the zloty falling victom to the rallying dollar and speculation," said Adam Roeske of Bank Gdanski SA.
One-day deposit bids eased, but offers remained flat as the money market continued to be plagued by low liquidity.
Overnight rates closed at 19.00/19.35 percent, against Monday's 19.15/19.35 and tomorrow/next at 19.05/19.40 percent against 19.02/19.40.
The National Bank of Poland raised its main 14-day reverse repo rate by 0.03 to 19.13 pct at todays' 242 million zloty drainage. It also sold 391 million zlotys of NBP-bills.
